limits: Intercepted synthetic responses only; no backend persistence, authorization, payment, entitlement, database, deployment or whole-site WCAG proof.
720x450 CSS viewport is a 200 percent reflow proxy, not native browser zoom.
Unsaved state is preserved for local hash/Back navigation and cached refresh. A full locale reload keeps URL context, not an invented cross-reload draft persistence.
Cold child-panel states retain their existing behavior; only the course-owner cached refresh display guard changed.
